headline: Siddharth Mehra files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Reg 10(6) for Savita Oil Technologies acquisition
sum: Siddharth Mehra has filed a disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 10(6), reporting an acquisition of Savita Oil Technologies Limited made under an exemption from the Takeover Code.
detail: Siddharth Mehra has made a disclosure to the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in respect of an acquisition in SOTL. The disclosure was filed on 18 June 2026. Regulation 10(6) permits reporting of acquisitions made under specified exemptions (e.g., creeping acquisition up to 5% per annum, preferential allotment, or employee stock option schemes), which do not trigger an open offer. The exact consideration, stake acquired, and exemption relied upon are contained in the filed disclosure document.
